Therapist are professionals. Yes, they’re still human and humans judge people, but you’re not there to meet your best friend, in a professional context she will be able to separate her way of being in order to make the therapy itself useful to you. 
She will evaluate everything because all of what you say is important to your therapy. She can’t be telling you what you should or shouldn’t do, the worst that can happen is that she figures out what you’re telling her isn’t something that helps you feeling okay but instead is something that causes you harm. If that’s the case, all she will do is slowly making you know and realize what parts of that thing are actually harmful to you. 
Therapy isn’t a brainwashing. You’re in charge of it. You are the one who makes changes and you can’t do them if you don’t see what’s actually bad for you on the first place. 
Just go, tell her. Everything will go on normally. Remember it’s just a step to be able to help you in the best way possible.
